value.rationale: A sharp \(a^2/b^2=8\) threshold for whether a *purely passive* local loss can induce a spectral exceptional point is physically meaningful and structurally nontrivial; two EP2 events merge to an EP3 at the codimension-one cusp. The all-imaginary spectral window is an exact qualitative regime. The \(K_{m,n}\) corollary converts the threshold into a complete all-graph-size absorber-placement obstruction with the star-hub exception, useful for network trapping and spectral design rather than a merely arbitrary parameter substitution.
